name: contract-case-capabilities
goal: Prevent documentation or declaration ordering changes from authorizing unexplained growth in an existing entity case suite

evidence: The existing compare method accepts added case IDs when a declaration description or origin changes. Expected: only actual supported signatures, examples, states, props or errors authorize case identity changes.

The original comparison case varied only case IDs and states. It missed non-capability metadata and order changes. Strengthened the same existing compare case with description/origin and symbol-order matrices; test count stays two.
